== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Masons]] are a respected order within the [[Consultants]], specializing in undercover infiltration and intelligence gathering. They function by training individuals in a wide variety of professional fields—such as alchemy, scholarship, or merchant work—allowing them to be positioned as experts who can relay information to the [[Consultant's Guild]]. While they rely heavily on disguises to perform their duties, they are sometimes criticized for lacking true stealth. The order operates out of the [[House of the Masons]] and views itself as a family rather than a military force, though they follow strict guild laws regarding their missions. The [[Masons]] are led by a Yala the High Mason{{!}}High Mason, a role held by Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala, who oversees the training and conduct of its members. Although they are primarily used for information gathering rather than assassination, their deep immersion in their professional roles can sometimes lead to complications.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|As members of a [[Guild]], [[Masons]] utilize various uniforms and disguises to perform their specialized work. This group includes trainees, servants, and individuals who wear aprons, with some even operating undercover within the [[Navigator’s Guild]]. Working alongside Shepherds to clean up after battles, the team is composed of twelve sailor [[Masons]] and fourteen combat-trained members. During their duties, a Mason was seen mounting a Waveriders{{!}}Waverider and assisting by hauling [[Shera]] onto the back of a [[Kameira]]. One such Mason also served the [[Greenwardens]] by providing training to [[Kameira]].}}
